scope: 2D design interpretation only, 3D production hold retained
prompt:
Use case: mechanical turnaround design. Create a clean TWO-VIEW full-body interpretation sheet of the SAME combined Social Brave King robot in image 1. Image 1 is the controlling exact combined design, image 2 only shows the complete humanoid core contained underneath, NOT a replacement appearance. Warm ivory landscape sheet 1792x1024, two full robots separated with clear space, aligned to one foot baseline, no writing or labels. Fine clean animation ink and hard orange/ivory/slate cel planes exactly like image 1, not photoreal.

Left panel: a pure left SIDE profile, facing image-left. Right panel: a REAR three-quarter view of exactly the same machine. Keep every component and proportions: compact silver/orange combined crown and long orange-white mane; blunt orange bomber cockpit/nose across the chest, complete central bomber fuselage, two large swept wings on independent rotary wing-root mounts and one engine beneath EACH wing; two real huge reinforced fists; two backward-facing undersea-train half-shell assemblies OUTSIDE the reinforced forearms; tread/drill vehicle armor outside lower legs and feet, forward knee drill on each leg. Whole figures, wings, hands, crown and feet fit inside the sheet.

Physical design constraints in both views:
The bomber center fuselage mounts to the upper back/chest of the complete core. Wing modules and their nacelles have visible separate roots and dark rotary bearings; the core shoulders beneath remain separate and can lift. Do not draw a second airplane, duplicate cockpit or new jetpack on the back.
The long mane belongs behind the helmet; in the rear-three-quarter view let it sweep to one side enough to expose the center-back aircraft mounting spine, without changing it to a short haircut or inventing a tail.
The train cab ends are toward the ELBOWS/rear, while the actual armored fists and opened front half-shells are toward the hand/front. In the side profile, the cab points toward image-right and the fist toward image-left. Preserve one train section per arm, not whole trains on the shoulders.
Knee drills are mounted to the FRONT of their own knee and follow each foot's forward direction. In the left side profile the visible drill points to image-LEFT, never backwards into the calf. Rear view has no extra rear-facing knee drills. Track assemblies stay outside shins/feet and do not replace the full core legs.
Do not shrink hands or shorten the tall legs. Every armor color and major panel landmark belongs to the same reference robot. These are structural interpretation views, not new costume variants. No added weapons, no electric effects, no numbered callout diagrams.
